diagnostic_criteria.symptoms: Cough, sore throat, nasal congestion, fever, malaise; viral vs. bacterial differentiation
tests: Chest X-ray if concerned for pneumonia

bacterial: Amoxicillin 500mg TID x 7 days (if penicillin allergic: azithromycin 500mg daily)

diagnostic_criteria.symptoms: Cough with purulent sputum, fever, dyspnea, pleuritic chest pain
tests: BNP if concerned for heart failure

outpatient: Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875mg BID x 7 days OR azithromycin 500mg daily x 5 days
hospitalized: IV ceftriaxone 1-2g daily + azithromycin 500mg daily OR IV fluoroquinolone

diagnostic_criteria.symptoms: Recurrent wheezing, breathlessness, chest tightness, cough (worse at night/exercise)

controller_therapy: Long-acting beta-agonist if inadequate control (combination ICS/LABA)
treatment_guidelines.monitoring: Spirometry every 1-2 years; assess control at each visit

diagnostic_criteria.symptoms: Progressive dyspnea on exertion, chronic cough, sputum production; history of smoking or biomass exposure

pharmacologic: ICS for frequent exacerbations or overlap with asthma
Phosphodiesterase-4 inhibitor (roflumilast) for chronic bronchitis with exacerbations

diagnostic_criteria.symptoms: Chronic cough (>3 weeks), fever, night sweats, weight loss, hemoptysis

intensive_phase: 4 drugs x 2 months: Isoniazid, Rifampicin, Pyrazinamide, Ethambutol
treatment_guidelines.monitoring: Sputum conversion by month 2; treatment outcome assessment

diagnostic_criteria.symptoms: Acute dyspnea, pleuritic chest pain, syncope; risk factors: immobilization, surgery, malignancy, hypercoagulability

anticoagulation: Unfractionated heparin bolus + infusion (preferred if PE-induced shock)
LMWH enoxaparin 1mg/kg SC BID or fondaparinux
Transition to warfarin (target INR 2-3) or DOAC (apixaban, rivaroxaban)
treatment_guidelines.duration: 3 months for provoked PE; 6+ months for unprovoked
treatment_guidelines.critical_care: IVC filter if anticoagulation contraindicated; consider thrombolysis if massive PE with shock
